Employment guarantee act, 2005
The Government, on the advice of the National Advisory Council;
has passed the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act. The main
features of the Act are
Every household in rural India will have & right to at least 100 days of
guaranteed employment every year for at least one adult member: The
employment will be in the form of casual manual labour atthe statutory
minimum wage, and the wages shall be paid wilhin 7 days of the week
during which work was done_
Work should be provided within 15 days of demanding it, and the work
should be located within 5 kilometer distance
If work is not provided to anybody within the given time, he /she will
be paid a daily unemployment allowance, which will be at least one-
third of the minimum wages
